summary:
Mini Map Macau is a single-page Vite/React + MapLibre app: a dark 3D map of Macau with simulated LRT trains, buses, flights and ferries. The UI is in Traditional Chinese. I saved 5 views, all at path /:
1. transit-map: the default screen. It shows the live map, the clock card, the Transport layer panel (LRT lines, bus route groups) and the 24h timeline with playback speeds.
2. city-layers: the layer panel on the City tab, with toggle cards (parishes, road works, parking, toilets…) and parish boundaries turned on so they show on the map.
3. time-picker: the "set time" popover. It has schedule-type cards, a date stepper, a large time readout with a service-density scrubber, preset times, and cancel/apply buttons.
4. follow-train: clicking an LRT train near East Asian Games station zooms the map in to follow it and opens a vehicle card (line, destination, speed, next stop, arrival/departure times). This uses a coordinate click on a moving train. It replayed correctly, but it depends on timing and may be flaky.
5. settings-drawer: the left menu with 2D/3D, buildings, dark mode, timeline and about toggles, font-size controls, a language switcher and data-source credits. I closed the layer panel first, because with the panel open the harness rejected this view as a near-duplicate of the main map.
Not captured: the light theme and other languages (I left the appearance as it was), the About dialog, and the other layer types (historical maps, utilities, Grand Prix). I also didn't capture an expanded bus route list or a station arrivals card: these replayed unreliably because changes I'd made earlier carried over in my browser session. I set those back to the defaults before saving the last views.
